title: Modeling Ranking Properties with In-Context Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the equitable exposure of documents associated with male and female demographic groups in search rankings using the TREC Fairness 2022 dataset and evaluating performance with the Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF) metric.

Evaluating the balanced representation of differing viewpoints (PRO and CON arguments) in search results using the Touché 2020 dataset and measuring exposure parity via the Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF) metric.
